discover.page.meta.title: Discover Cyprus Winter | Beaches, Villages, Wineries
discover.page.meta.description: Cyprus in winter: curated places that feel real. Beaches, ancient sites, villages, wineries—plus bouldering, cycling, and coast adventures. Sixteen degrees when home is six.
discover.page.meta.filters.nature.title: Cyprus Winter Nature & Coasts | Beaches, Gorges & Trails
discover.page.meta.filters.nature.descri: Cyprus winter nature and coast: empty beaches, Akamas gorges, Cape Greco cliffs. Mild days, golden light, no summer crowds. Curated coast and nature spots with pairings.
discover.page.meta.filters.ancient.title: Ancient Sites Cyprus Winter | Kourion, Paphos & Tombs
discover.page.meta.filters.ancient.descr: Cyprus ancient sites in winter: Kourion theatre, Paphos mosaics, Tombs of the Kings. Soft light, fewer tour buses. Curated ruins with village and winery pairings.
discover.page.meta.filters.village.title: Cyprus Villages Winter | Omodos, Lefkara & Platres
discover.page.meta.filters.village.descr: Cyprus villages in winter: Omodos cobbles, Lefkara lace, Platres forest squares. Kafenions, fireside wine, empty lanes midweek. Curated village stops.
discover.page.meta.filters.wine.title: Cyprus Wineries Winter | Tastings & Wine Routes
discover.page.meta.filters.wine.descript: Cyprus winter wineries: Krasochoria, Laona, Commandaria. Fireside tastings, cosy cellars, book ahead. Curated wine stops with food and village pairings.
discover.page.meta.filters.monastery.tit: Cyprus Monasteries Winter | Kykkos, Troodos & Culture
discover.page.meta.filters.monastery.des: Cyprus monasteries in winter: Kykkos, Machairas, quiet Troodos cloisters. Layer up, respect dress codes, pair with forest walks. Curated culture stops.
discover.page.meta.filters.hidden.title: Hidden Cyprus Winter | Secret Spots & Local Gems
discover.page.meta.filters.hidden.descri: Hidden Cyprus winter: local secrets, quiet viewpoints, off-radar kafenions. Curated gems away from summer crowds — pair with trails and villages.
discover.page.meta.filters.family.title: Family-Friendly Cyprus Winter | Beaches & Gentle Days
discover.page.meta.filters.family.descri: Cyprus winter with kids: calm beaches, lace villages, easy museums. Two stops per day, rain-day backups. Curated family-friendly places.
discover.page.meta.filters.accessible.ti: Accessible Cyprus Winter | Gentle Paths & Museums
discover.page.meta.filters.accessible.de: Lower-mobility winter Cyprus: paved sites, manageable villages, ground-floor museums. Curated accessible and gentle places.
discover.page.meta.filters.local.title: Local Winter Cyprus | Museums, Villages & Slow Days
discover.page.meta.filters.local.descrip: Winter like a local: Nicosia museums, lace villages, stone sites—fewer tour buses, more kafenion time.
discover.page.meta.filters.bouldering.ti: Bouldering in Cyprus Winter | Crags & Gyms
discover.page.meta.filters.bouldering.de: Outdoor boulders and climbing gyms across Cyprus—Gerakopetra, Episkopi, Droushia, Limassol walls. Winter temps ideal. Curated list with pairings.
discover.page.meta.filters.climbing.titl: Rock Climbing Cyprus Winter | Crags & Coast
discover.page.meta.filters.climbing.desc: Rock climbing and coastal scrambles in Cyprus winter—Cape Greco, Kourion, Episkopi, Petra tou Romiou. Layer up; check access. Curated crags and nearby villages.
discover.page.meta.filters.cycling.title: Cycling in Cyprus Winter | Troodos & Coastal Loops
discover.page.meta.filters.cycling.descr: Cyprus winter cycling: Troodos dam roads, Krasochoria gravel, Akamas coast, village loops. Mild coast, cooler mountains. Curated routes and cafés.
discover.page.meta.filters.watersports.t: Watersports Cyprus Winter | Dive, Kayak & Coast
discover.page.meta.filters.watersports.d: Diving, kayaking, and coastal adventures in Cyprus winter—Latchi, Zenobia wreck, Cape Greco, Lara shores. Calm days; book dive centres ahead.
discover.page.meta.filters.quiet.title: Quiet Escapes Cyprus Winter | Villages & Hidden Gems
discover.page.meta.filters.quiet.descrip: Quiet Cyprus winter: lace villages, forest hamlets, kafenions with one local at the bar. Curated slow-travel spots away from summer crowds.
discover.page.meta.filters.mountains.tit: Cyprus Mountains in Winter | Troodos Villages
discover.page.meta.filters.mountains.des: Troodos and Pitsilia in winter: Platres, Kykkos, snow-dusted peaks, village squares. Pack layers; check trail conditions. Curated mountain stops.
discover.page.meta.filters.wellness.titl: Wellness Cyprus Winter | Monasteries & Forest Bathing
discover.page.meta.filters.wellness.desc: Winter wellness in Cyprus: thermal villages, forest bathing, quiet monasteries, spa coast. Curated calm spaces and gentle walks.
